exposure: sociodemographic characteristics (age, race, education, payment status, partnership status)
cohort: The study included 424 postpartum women attended in maternity hospitals in Sao Paulo.
finding: The study described the sociodemographic and obstetric profile of postpartum women in Sao Paulo, finding a predominance of women aged 21-30, mulatto, with high school education, and reporting that most newborns had appropriate weight, height, and good Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was performed in 58.3% of the women.
